title: Fit once. Transform both datasets consistently.

blocks.text: A pipeline must preserve the distinction between learning a transformation and applying it. Standardization, for example, learns a mean and scale. If the test set is standardized with its own statistics, the model sees test values in a different coordinate system. If train and test are combined before fitting the scaler, information from evaluation data enters training.
Fit a chain of sklearn-compatible transformers on training data only, fit a cloned estimator, and predict test data. Return predictions and fitted components.

An estimator learns parameters from training data. A transformer learns a preprocessing rule and applies it to data. fit learns that rule; transform applies an already learned rule. A clone creates an unfitted estimator with the same configuration.

The supplied function maintains two arrays. The training array passes through fit_transform; the test array passes through transform on the same newly fitted object. Each subsequent transformer receives the previous transformer’s output. The final estimator is cloned and fitted only on the transformed training features and training targets.

blocks.text: Connect the picture to the mathematics

blocks.caption: T is a fitted transformation. Both datasets use the same fitted T; test rows never participate in its fit.

blocks.text: The animation changes the test input while leaving the training rows fixed. The learned mean remains two in both scenarios. A distant test input receives a large standardized value, which accurately reflects its distance from the training distribution. Re-centering on the test row would hide that information. The example’s linear relationship remains exactly predictable because the fitted linear model uses the same coordinate system.

Cloning helps avoid accidental reuse of an already fitted object, but it does not automatically prevent leakage elsewhere. The caller still controls the train/test split, feature construction, and whether a target-dependent transformer receives valid training labels. The returned fitted components should be reused for later inference in the same order. Check that test changes do not alter fitted transformer statistics, and verify that original estimator objects were not mutated. A complete production pipeline also needs consistent column definitions and persistence.
blocks.title: The boundary of this implementation

notes.text: Training data learns and receives the transformation.
Test data receives the learned rule without fitting again.
The final estimator learns only from transformed training data.

q132-new-case.prompt: A fitted scaler has mean 10 and scale 2. What transformed value corresponds to an unseen input 14?

explanation.default: Revisit the stated quantities and units. Apply the stored transformation: (14−10)/2=2.

q132-prediction.prompt: Training values are 1, 2, 3. What mean should the scaler use even if the test value changes to 14?

explanation.correct: Only the training values determine the mean: (1+2+3)/3=2.
explanation.default: Revisit the stated quantities and units. Only the training values determine the mean: (1+2+3)/3=2.
